model.release_source: The card maker of the 2026 papers. Same model, instructions, profile versions (anvur-method-v2, anvur-impact-v2), input format and max_output_tokens as the Batch that made the 2,611 / 2,614 cards of the corpus papers on 18 Oct 2026 (job 20261018T134621203476Z: no reasoning parameter, i.e. the model's default), so the cards of a 2026 paper and of its neighbours are made the same way. The card only DESCRIBES the paper with exact quotations (checked by paper_cards.repair_card); the judges, whose knowledge must precede the papers, are in evaluation_pre2026.json. Only judge_1 is used; judge_2 is required by the schema.
not used (the schema needs two roles)
